provider.title: AI provider
provider.privacy: Only thumbnails (max 512px) or extracted text are sent — never whole files. Keys stay in this browser.

none.title: Off
none.text: Local analysis only (duplicates, bad photos, keyword search).

ollama.title: Local — Ollama
ollama.text: Runs on this computer. Nothing leaves your machine.

openai.title: Your cloud — OpenAI-compatible
openai.text: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, gateways, LM Studio, vLLM…

anthropic.title: Your cloud — Anthropic
anthropic.text: Your Claude API key. Bedrock and Vertex can be set up for your organization in account mode.

folderpilot.title: FolderPilot AI
folderpilot.text: Our hosted Claude. Only small thumbnails or extracted text are sent, counted against your organization's monthly AI budget.

provider.autoAnalyze: Analyze new files with AI automatically after indexing
provider.autoRun: Let the agent apply small plans by itself, up to this many files:
provider.autoRunHint: 0 = always ask (default). Moving to the Trash and rule changes always need you.

fields.textModelHint: For documents and the agent (needs tool support)
fields.anthropicNoEmbeddings: No embeddings with this provider, so search uses keywords.

ollamaSetup.title: Allow FolderPilot to talk to Ollama (one time):
ollamaSetup.windows: Windows: set an environment variable, then restart Ollama.

semantic.title: Semantic search
semantic.description: Find files by meaning (“tax papers for the bakery”), not just by words. Needs a provider with embeddings.
semantic.useInSearch: Use semantic search in the search bar

thresholds.title: Analysis thresholds
thresholds.description: Tune what counts as a near-duplicate or a bad photo. Flags update right away.

data.title: Data
data.description: FolderPilot's index lives in this browser. Removing it never touches your files.
data.forgetConfirm: Forget “{{name}}”? Its index and pending plans are removed from FolderPilot (the audit log is kept). Your files stay exactly where they are.

org.title: AI for your organization
org.description: Used for server spaces (Cloud, Connect and self-hosted Private mode). Keys are stored encrypted on the server and never shown again.
org.folderpilotUnavailable: FolderPilot AI isn't configured on this server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, see docs/SETUP.md).

fields.name: Display name
fields.budgetHint: AI analysis stops for the month when this many files have been described. Cached results don't count.
fields.autoRunHint: Agent plans touching at most this many files apply without approval (still logged and undoable). 0 = always ask. Trash and rule changes always need a person.

org.bedrockHint: Leave the keys empty to use the server's AWS credentials (environment or instance role).
org.vertexHint: Leave the JSON empty to use the server's Google credentials (application default).
org.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
org.deviceTitle: AI for folders on this device
